agentAccess.lede: Agents we run on our own systems. They read what applies to them here and change nothing.
agentAccess.reachLine.on: Our register decisions can be read by entries that allow it.
agentAccess.reachLine.off: Our register decisions stay in bleqq: every entry reads the shared library only. Switching this on needs two people holding security manage.
agentAccess.reachLine.unknown: Whether our own agents may read our register decisions is set under Security.
agentAccess.emptyBody: Register an agent we run ourselves so it can read what applies to its work.
agentAccess.registered: Registered. Issue it a key to let it read.
agentAccess.credentialCount: {keys, plural, =0 {No keys} one {# key} other {# keys}}
agentAccess.tokenCount: {tokens, plural, one {# personal token} other {# personal tokens}}
agentAccess.field.name: Name
agentAccess.field.nameHint: What we call it. It shows in the access log.
agentAccess.field.purposeHint: One sentence on what it builds, buys or reviews.
agentAccess.field.purposeRequired: Say in one sentence what it is for.
agentAccess.field.teamHint: The team that answers for it.
agentAccess.field.teamRequired: Choose the team that answers for it.
agentAccess.field.scopeHint: It reads what these departments and products touch, within our regulatory scope. Name none and it reads all of our regulatory scope.
agentAccess.field.readsNothing: What you named touches nothing in our regulatory scope, so this agent would read nothing. Name a product too, or name nothing to read all of our regulatory scope.
agentAccess.field.pickerError: Could not load this list. You can still save without it.
agentAccess.dialog.editApplies: A change applies to its next call.
agentAccess.stale: Someone else changed this agent while you were editing. Your changes are not saved.
agentAccess.entry.notFound: There is nothing at this address in your organisation.
agentAccess.entry.scopeNote: Obligations that name none of our products or activities stay in view; one about another product alone does not. When an answer touches what it cannot see, it says so and tells the agent to ask compliance.
agentAccess.entry.revokedNote: Its credentials stopped working. The entry and its access log stay, read-only.
agentAccess.reach.title: Our register
agentAccess.reach.toggleHint: Applicability and its reason, compliance status, how we read each rule, owners and linked items, for the obligations in its scope. Never gaps, cases, comments or evidence.
agentAccess.reach.changeHint: Changing it asks for your passkey.
agentAccess.reach.offReason: Our register stays in bleqq until two people holding security manage allow it. Until then this agent reads the shared library only.
agentAccess.keys.title: Credentials
agentAccess.keys.lede: Keys read as this agent. A member's personal token that names it reads as that member, within this agent's scope.
agentAccess.keys.empty: No keys yet. Issue one so the agent can read.
agentAccess.keys.revokeBody: Its next call is refused. The key stays on the list as revoked, and its calls stay in the access log.
agentAccess.issue.title: Issue a key for {name}
agentAccess.issue.name: Name
agentAccess.issue.nameHint: Where the key will live, so you know which to revoke.
agentAccess.issue.scopesRequired: Choose at least one thing it may read.
agentAccess.issue.scope.library:read: Instruments and obligations in its scope
agentAccess.issue.scope.search:read: Search the library in its scope
agentAccess.issue.scope.upcoming:read: Dated changes that touch its scope
agentAccess.issue.scope.tenant:read: Our register decisions, while our register is readable
agentAccess.issue.expiresHint: Leave it empty for the longest a key may live. A key never lives longer than the platform allows.
agentAccess.newKey.title: Copy the key now
agentAccess.newKey.body: It is not shown again. Store it where the agent keeps its secrets.
agentAccess.revoke.title: Revoke {name}?
agentAccess.revoke.body: Every key and personal token under it stops working on its next call. The entry and its access log are kept, and it cannot be switched back on: register it again if it is needed.
agentAccess.log.title: Access log
agentAccess.log.lede: Every call, newest first. What was asked and what was answered are never kept.
agentAccess.log.errorTitle: Could not load the access log
agentAccess.log.emptyBody: Calls appear here once the agent uses a key. Issue one above if it has none.
agentAccess.log.narrowed: {count, plural, =0 {Narrowed to nothing} one {# term} other {# terms}}
agentAccess.refusal.stale: Someone else changed this agent first. Nothing was saved.
agentAccess.refusal.invalidTransition: This agent is revoked, so it cannot change.
agentAccess.refusal.unknownKey: Something you chose is no longer ours to choose. Reload and try again.
agentAccess.refusal.purposeRequired: Say in one sentence what it is for.
agentAccess.refusal.expiryTooLate: That is further ahead than a key may live. Choose an earlier date, or leave it empty for the longest allowed.
agentAccess.tenantReach.title: Our register and our own agents
agentAccess.tenantReach.off: Off. The agents we register under Agents, Access read the shared library only; our register decisions stay in bleqq.
agentAccess.tenantReach.offHint: Switching it on lets each agent we allow read our applicability decisions, compliance status and how we read each rule, for the obligations in its scope. It needs two of us holding security manage: one asks, another approves, each with a passkey.
agentAccess.tenantReach.askHint: Asking asks for your passkey. Nothing changes until another member holding security manage approves.
agentAccess.tenantReach.asked: Asked. Another member holding security manage can approve it here.
agentAccess.tenantReach.pendingMine: You asked to switch this on, {date}. Another member holding security manage approves or rejects it. Until then it stays off.
agentAccess.tenantReach.pendingMineNote: There is nothing for you to do here: the decision is someone else's.
agentAccess.tenantReach.pendingOther: {name} asked to switch this on, {date}. Approving lets each agent we allow read our register decisions in its scope.
agentAccess.tenantReach.decideHint: Approving and rejecting ask for your passkey.
agentAccess.tenantReach.approved: Approved. Entries whose own reach is on read our register decisions from their next call.
agentAccess.tenantReach.rejected: Rejected. It stays off, and it can be asked for again.
agentAccess.tenantReach.fourEyesBody: You asked for it, so another member holding security manage decides it. Nothing changed.
agentAccess.tenantReach.onHint: Switching it off stops every entry reading our register on its next call. Switching it back on needs two of us again.
agentAccess.tenantReach.offBody: Every entry reads the shared library only from its next call. Each entry keeps its own setting for when this is switched on again.
agentAccess.tenantReach.offStepUp: Switching off asks for your passkey.
agentAccess.tenantReach.switchedOff: Switched off. Every entry now reads the shared library only.
agentAccess.tenantReach.readOnly: Whether our own agents may read our register is changed by a member holding {permission}.
agentAccess.tenantReach.errorTitle: Could not load whether our register can be read
agentAccess.tenantReach.requestPending: A request already waits for a decision.
agentAccess.tenantReach.alreadyDecided: Someone decided this first. The panel now shows where it stands.
agentAccess.readOnly: Registering and changing these agents needs {permission}.
